text:
Sam: Heads-up — WellSpring trial blocked at final onboarding step. Billing attach fails with 422 validation error when we post subscription. Support opened SUP-10021. Customer has renewal sync in 4 days, marking P0. :rotating_light:
Tasha: Oof. Can you paste the error and steps? Ill draft a customer note if this looks like a renewal risk.
Sam: Error payload from logs:
```
2026-04-01T11:22:05Z ERROR payment_create status=422 body={"error":"invalid_billing_account","field":"tax_id"}
2026-04-01T11:22:06Z INFO retry attempt=1
```
Sam: Steps: (1) customer completes billing form -> (2) our API calls /payments/create -> (3) 422 returned -> UI shows "Billing info invalid", can't finish setup. Happened for 6 seats across two admins.
Ibrahim: Sounds like our stricter tax_id validation rolled out last night flagged their non-US format. Which region/account type?
Sam: Theyre EU-based (DE) and use a VAT ID format with country prefix. Our validator expects numeric-only.
Ibrahim: Yep, rollout introduced stricter regex. Quick mitigation: enable compatibility-mode for billing-validation on tenant=wellspring for 72h to accept VAT IDs with country code and log mismatches. I can flip now and add audit.
DeployBot: feature.toggle.billing_compat_mode set=true for tenant=wellspring (by Ibrahim)
Ibrahim: toggled. Can support ask customer to retry?
Sam: Customer retried and all 6 seats progressed to "active". They finished onboarding. :white_check_mark:
Tasha: Draft for customer (keep non-technical): "Hi Lena — were sorry your team hit an error when attaching billing details. We applied a temporary change to allow your VAT ID format while we release a permanent fix. Our engineers will deploy a patch tomorrow and well confirm once its in place. Wed like to offer a one-time 15% credit for the inconvenience and a 30-minute walkthrough to confirm everythings complete. — Tasha, Customer Success"
Nikki: Finance approved the 15% credit. Please put exact credit amount when sending.
Ibrahim: Plan: revert validator to new stricter rules but accept country-prefixed VAT IDs; add unit test for DE VAT formats; release ETA 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Ill own deploy and rollback plan.
Tasha: Ill send the customer message after removing any internal flag names. Sam  please add SUP-10021 link to the walkthrough calendar invite.
Sam: Invite sent to Lena + engineering contact; SUP-10021 link added.
Tasha: Customer reply: "Thanks — were unblocked and can join the walkthrough tomorrow. Appreciate the quick help."
Ibrahim: Will deploy tomorrow morning and switch billing_compat_mode=false after verification. Ill post release notes.
Sam: Closing SUP-10021 as workaround validated. Account health: flagged at-risk -> recovering.
Tasha: Tracking: 1) Release fix & tests (Ibrahim) ETA 2026-04-02 09:00 PT, 2) Rollback temp compat flag after verification (Ibrahim), 3) Post-deploy follow-up (Tasha), 4) Walkthrough session (Sam). Noting renewal as "elevated risk" until post-deploy confirmation. Thanks team :handshake:
